summary: Frontend-only smoke of the rebuilt Partner tabs (Dashboard / Job Request / Active Job / Wallet & Withdraw / More) on mobile web (390x844) using Partner Demo one-tap login. All target testIDs render, all API calls returned 200, no red-box or console errors (only benign useNativeDriver warning). Header (bell + unread badge, theme toggle light↔dark, profile dropdown with Edit Profile / Logout) works. Bottom nav shows 5 pills incl. Active-Job red badge (3) matching backend. Job Request shows Online status + Refresh + radar empty card + 'Live dispatch connected · Updated 07:55 PM' footer. Active tab lists 3 ActiveJob cards with WORK IN PROGRESS banner + running elapsed timer, job-stepper, Demo OTP hint, Navigate/Call/Chat, both Collapse sections; Completed chip toggles to green + 6 completed cards. Wallet hero shows ₹449.25 + Withdrawable/Pending/Withdrawn boxes, KYC amber blocker present (demo partner not eligible), Withdraw Money taps route to /partner/payouts, KPI cards + SegTabs + tx search + credit/debit/all + pagination + 3 withdrawal items all present. More sheet → Job History → /partner/history renders with All/Completed/Cancelled filters and list. Backend network sample: /site/config, /auth/config, /notifications, /partner/wallet, /partner/wallet/config, /partner/withdrawals, /partner/finance-kyc, /bookings/partner/{jobs,active,missed,history} all 200.

issues: 'Wallet & Withdraw' label truncates to 'Wallet & Wit…' at 390px because tab label maxWidth=64 with numberOfLines=1. Expected per spec ('may truncate'), acceptable but consider a shorter label like 'Wallet'.

critical_code_review_comments: AppShellHeader.tsx uses `refetchInterval` implicitly missing on notifs query — unread badge only refreshes on tab focus/mount. Consider `refetchInterval: 60000` for parity with web bell polling.

active.tsx: `OtpBoxes` is reused for both Start-OTP and Complete-OTP but shares a single `otp` state; if a partner starts typing Start OTP then switches to another card the value can leak. Low-priority since only rendered per-card.
jobs.tsx `earnFracOf` defaults to 0.75 when commission_config is absent — matches web but may over-quote earning; keep in mind for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo partner Raj Kumar (+919000000003).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner shell + 4 tab screens validated on mobile web viewport 390x844. Demo partner has ~3 active jobs (one 'started' with Demo OTPs visible), 6 completed jobs, wallet balance ₹449.25, not KYC-eligible (amber blocker + tap-through to /partner/payouts). All partner APIs return 200. Completing a real OTP was intentionally skipped to preserve seed data; OTP boxes render correctly and Complete Job button is disabled until 4 digits.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
